issue.title: Replay saved pages (-H) for multi-URL bob ref create collections

task_type_fields.proposal: Let `bob ref create URL URL… ` replay saved pages for a multi-URL collection, so a reading packet from a site that blocks or times out headless/headed browser navigation can still become one reference. Today `-H/--html` with two or more URLs exits 2 (`--html replays one saved page; several URLs are captured live`, src/native/highlights_ref/collection.rs validate_targets). The design needs a pairing grammar (for example a repeatable `-H FILE` matched to URLs by position, or `URL=FILE` targets), must keep the fail-fast/no-network gate for naming, and must feed each saved page into the existing per-part `render:false` capture before `compose`. Evidence: bob-cli-7v.7's live verification of a two-part Squarespace collection timed out in the browser on both runs (dry run on part 2, real run on part 1 after 45 s) while plain curl fetched both URLs, and collection `--html` replay was unavailable as a workaround. Proposed by the plan of epic bob-cli-7v (out-of-scope list: "-H with several URLs"), recorded by the bob-cli-7v land agent.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic bob-cli-7v deliberately scoped v1 collections to live captures; its plan lists `-H` with several URLs as an explicit out-of-scope follow-up, and the pairing grammar is a CLI design decision the epic never made.

issue.creation_reason: Live verification of epic bob-cli-7v could not capture a two-part collection because browser navigation timed out, and collections have no saved-page replay fallback.
